Messages.Body:
-May I use a card like Pulling strings (or similar) to prevent a Priscus
from voting in the sub-referendum?

-Propaganda at superior: when is the minion tapped? As the action is
announced or after it resolves? Who chooses which minion is to be
tapped?

Thank you.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
massimo isola <sund...@tin.it> writes:

> -May I use a card like Pulling strings (or similar) to prevent a Priscus
> from voting in the sub-referendum?

You could use it to alter the votes of a Priscus, which would include
all "normal" votes (e.g. Surprise Influence) as well as sub-referendum
votes.

If a Priscus is forced to abstain or to change his votes, then this
includes his votes in the Prisci sub-referendum as well as his votes
(if any) in the main referendum. [LSJ 19970224]

> -Propaganda at superior: when is the minion tapped? As the action is
> announced or after it resolves? Who chooses which minion is to be
> tapped?

When it resolves.

Like all actions, its effects only take place if the action is
successful.
